# Avatar Group

Overlapping stack of user avatars (image or initials) with an optional +N counter. One row per person.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_AVATAR_GROUP` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/avatarGroup` |
| Modes | report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.0 |
| Based on | [Magic UI](https://magicui.design/docs/components/avatar-circles) (MIT) |

Each row is one person: map Name, and Image URL or Initials. To show a counter, add a final row whose Overflow Text is for example +12 (union it in SQL).

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | Name | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Person's name: used as tooltip and accessible name. |
| `imageUrl` | Image URL | sessionStateValue |  |  | Avatar image URL, for example built with apex_util.get_blob_file_src or #APP_FILES#. Leave empty to show initials. |
| `initials` | Initials | sessionStateValue |  |  | One or two letters shown when there is no image, for example apex_string.get_initials(name). |
| `linkUrl` | Link URL | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional target when the avatar is clicked (developer-controlled URL). |
| `overflowText` | Overflow Text | sessionStateValue |  |  | When set, the row renders as a counter bubble (for example +12) instead of an avatar. |
| `size` | Size | selectList (`small`, `large`) |  |  | Avatar diameter. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/avatar-group/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_avatar_group.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
